Diabetes Dataset Multiple Regression \
Running simple model for multiple regression

# Data Preview
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(car)
diabetes <- read.csv("https://data.mendeley.com/public-files/datasets/xv25yjbzkm/files/a0843021-a3bd-4737-96c0-a19cacb84e54/file_downloaded")
diabetes <- na.omit(diabetes) #Clear rows with missing values in this case there are none
head(diabetes, 10)

# Make column names easier to type
names(diabetes) <- make.names(names(diabetes))

# Convert text variables to categorical variables
diabetes$Gender <- as.factor(diabetes$Gender)
diabetes$Family.History <- as.factor(diabetes$Family.History)
diabetes$Hypertension <- as.factor(diabetes$Hypertension) 
diabetes$Outcome <- as.factor(diabetes$Outcome) 
diabetes$Physical.Activity <- as.factor(diabetes$Physical.Activity)
diabetes$Smoking.Status <- as.factor(diabetes$Smoking.Status)
diabetes$Alcohol.Intake <- as.factor(diabetes$Alcohol.Intake) 

# Basic inspection
dim(diabetes)
head(diabetes)
str(diabetes)
summary(diabetes)

# Missing values and duplicate rows
colSums(is.na(diabetes))
sum(duplicated(diabetes))
```

# Simple multiple reression model
```{r}
dmodel <- lm(Glucose ~ Gender + Age + Physical.Activity + Smoking.Status
+ Alcohol.Intake + Blood.Pressure + Skin.Thickness + Insulin + BMI
+ Cholesterol + Diabetes.Pedigree.Function + Family.History
+ Hypertension, data = diabetes)
summary(dmodel)
```

# Residual plots
```{r}
residualPlots(dmodel)
```

# Plot distibutions
```{r}
# Four plots in one plotting window
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

hist(diabetes$Glucose,
     main = "Distribution of glucose",
     xlab = "Glucose", col = "lightblue", breaks = 30)

hist(diabetes$BMI,
     main = "Distribution of BMI",
     xlab = "BMI", col = "lightgreen", breaks = 30)

hist(diabetes$Age,
     main = "Distribution of age",
     xlab = "Age", col = "wheat", breaks = 20)

barplot(table(diabetes$Outcome),
        main = "Diabetes status",
        ylab = "Number of observations",
        col = c("lightblue", "salmon"))

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

# Explore relationships
```{r}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

plot(Glucose ~ BMI, data = diabetes,
     pch = 16, col = adjustcolor("steelblue", alpha.f = 0.1),
     main = "Glucose versus BMI")
abline(lm(Glucose ~ BMI, data = diabetes),
       col = "red", lwd = 2)

plot(Glucose ~ Age, data = diabetes,
     pch = 16, col = adjustcolor("steelblue", alpha.f = 0.1),
     main = "Glucose versus age")
abline(lm(Glucose ~ Age, data = diabetes),
       col = "red", lwd = 2)

plot(Glucose ~ Blood.Pressure, data = diabetes,
     pch = 16, col = adjustcolor("steelblue", alpha.f = 0.1),
     main = "Glucose versus blood pressure")
abline(lm(Glucose ~ Blood.Pressure, data = diabetes),
       col = "red", lwd = 2)

plot(Glucose ~ Skin.Thickness, data = diabetes,
     pch = 16, col = adjustcolor("steelblue", alpha.f = 0.1),
     main = "Glucose versus skin thickness")
abline(lm(Glucose ~ Skin.Thickness, data = diabetes),
       col = "red", lwd = 2)

plot(Glucose ~ Cholesterol, data = diabetes,
     pch = 16, col = adjustcolor("steelblue", alpha.f = 0.1),
     main = "Glucose versus cholesterol")
abline(lm(Glucose ~ Cholesterol, data = diabetes),
       col = "red", lwd = 2)

plot(Glucose ~ Diabetes.Pedigree.Function, data = diabetes,
     pch = 16, col = adjustcolor("steelblue", alpha.f = 0.1),
     main = "Glucose versus diabetes pedigree function")
abline(lm(Glucose ~ Diabetes.Pedigree.Function, data = diabetes),
       col = "red", lwd = 2)

boxplot(Glucose ~ Physical.Activity, data = diabetes,
        main = "Glucose by activity level",
        xlab = "Physical activity", ylab = "Glucose",
        col = "lightblue")

boxplot(Glucose ~ Smoking.Status, data = diabetes,
        main = "Glucose by smoking status",
        xlab = "Smoking status", ylab = "Glucose",
        col = "lightblue")

boxplot(Glucose ~ Alcohol.Intake, data = diabetes,
        main = "Glucose by alcohol intake",
        xlab = "Alcohol intake", ylab = "Glucose",
        col = "lightblue")

boxplot(Glucose ~ Outcome, data = diabetes,
        main = "Glucose by diabetes status",
        xlab = "", ylab = "Glucose",
        col = c("lightblue", "salmon"))

boxplot(Glucose ~ Family.History, data = diabetes,
        main = "Glucose by family history",
        xlab = "Family history", ylab = "Glucose",
        col = c("lightblue", "salmon"))

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# Correlations among numeric variables
numeric_data <- diabetes[vapply(diabetes, is.numeric, logical(1))]
round(cor(numeric_data, use = "complete.obs"), 3)
```

# More regression models
```{r}
# Simple linear regression
m1 <- lm(Glucose ~ BMI, data = diabetes)

# Adjust for age and gender
m2 <- lm(Glucose ~ BMI + Age + Gender, data = diabetes)

# Add physical activity
m3 <- lm(
  Glucose ~ BMI + Age + Gender + Physical.Activity,
  data = diabetes
)

summary(m1)
summary(m2)
summary(m3)

# Confidence intervals for the coefficients
confint(m3)

# Compare nested models
# These comparisons require models fitted to the same observations.
anova(m1, m2, m3)

# Standard regression diagnostic plots
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(m3)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
